label: MiniMax-H3 T2V+A 480p, 1x 32 GB consumer GPU
prompt: At night, while their owner sleeps in a bedroom, three cats march in loudly playing tiny brass instruments, then abruptly file out.
_note: The consumer tier: one RTX 5090 (32 GB) on a 60 GB desktop host, the machine class the sglang cookbook measured on a physical desktop (docs/cookbook/diffusion/MiniMax/MiniMax-H3.mdx, section 'RTX 5090 single card, physical desktop' (sglang main 3831e7e09, checked 2026-10-10)). Workload is that comparison's: FL2VA T2VA, 864x480, 124 frames, 20 steps, no CFG, sigma shift 12/3. Every engine streams weights from disk, so the drive and host RAM are part of the measurement. Record them with the result. Single-request only: a request takes about two minutes, and neither engine batches on this card.

default.description: One 32 GB GPU on a 60 GB host: DiT, text encoder and video VAE layerwise-offloaded, 14 DiT blocks and 36 video-VAE blocks resident.
default.serve_args: --model-type diffusion --warmup-mode server --model-variant fl2va --performance-mode memory --layerwise-offload-components dit,text_encoder,vae --dit-layerwise-resident-layers 14 --layerwise-resident-layers video_vae=36 --warmup-resolutions 864x480 --warmup-num-frames 124 --enable-torch-compile false
default.notes: The cookbook's '32 GB VRAM + 60 GB host, lossless' command, verbatim (docs/cookbook/diffusion/MiniMax/MiniMax-H3.mdx, section 'RTX 5090 single card, physical desktop' (sglang main 3831e7e09, checked 2026-10-10)). It reports 112.2 s per request against ComfyUI --fast-disk --cache-none at 140.9-145.9 s on an RTX 5090, Ryzen 9 9950X, 60 GB RAM, PCIe 5.0 NVMe. VALIDATION PENDING (2026-10-10 round, rdxa-5090-pa).
default.policy_exception: Correctness exception, not a speed tradeoff: MiniMax-H3's torch.compile path changes numerical output per the sglang cookbook (docs/cookbook/diffusion/MiniMax/MiniMax-H3.mdx, checked 2026-08-07) -- compile is not enabled by any recommended lossless preset for this model and must not be used to generate consistency ground truth. --enable-torch-compile stays false in every profile for this case until upstream fixes the numerics.

vllm-omni.reason: MiniMax-H3 holds about 108 GB of weights (61.73 GB DiT + 46.18 GB text encoder, per the sglang cookbook) and this case's host has 60 GB of RAM. vLLM-Omni's MiniMax-H3 recipe documents no single-32 GB-GPU command, and its offload keeps the streamed weights in host RAM, which cannot hold them here. Not attempted in the 2026-10-10 round.

default.description: ComfyUI master, the official H3 T2VA workflow at full precision, disk-backed weight loading for a 60 GB host.
default.notes: Same graph and weights as minimax_h3_t2va_5s's ComfyUI default (bf16 DiT, bf16 Qwen3-VL-32B, fp16 video VAE; BasicGuider, shift 12/3). The cookbook found ComfyUI's default launch OOM-killed during load on a 60 GB host (55.6 GB anonymous memory) and measured it with --fast-disk --cache-none (docs/cookbook/diffusion/MiniMax/MiniMax-H3.mdx, section 'RTX 5090 single card, physical desktop' (sglang main 3831e7e09, checked 2026-10-10)). Compile is off; see policy_exception. VALIDATION PENDING (2026-10-10 round, rdxa-5090-pa).
default.policy_exception: Compile broken, not a speed choice (2026-10-10, ComfyUI 0df64eb2 on torch 2.14.1+cu130, 1x RTX 5090, rdxa-5090-pa): with TorchCompileModel in front of the MiniMax-H3 DiT, --fast-disk's dynamic loading (comfy/model_prefetch.py -> comfy_aimdo malloc_graph.record) runs inside the dynamo trace, where the current stream is a generic torch.Stream with no cuda_stream, and the first request fails in SamplerCustomAdvanced. --fast-disk cannot be dropped on a 60 GB host (the cookbook found the default launch OOM-killed at load), so this cell runs eager.
